name: voidhash/example-backend-php
description: Nimbus — the Voidhash PHP SDK reference backend.
_comment: This example resolves the SDK from the checkout next door so it always builds against the source in this repository.
In your own project drop the `repositories` block and the `@dev` constraint and run: composer require voidhash/voidhash-php

scripts.lint: find src public scripts -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
